channel.title: N3X Realty blog
channel.description: Guides for real estate agents on websites, lead follow-up, local SEO and AI search.

item.title: What every real estate agent website needs: a 3-page checklist
item.description: You don't need a 40-page site to look professional and win leads. Here is exactly what to put on three pages, and the basics most agent sites forget.

item.title: How fast should you respond to a new real estate lead?
item.description: The short answer is: as fast as you possibly can, in a way that sounds like you. Here is a first-message script and a 30-day follow-up plan.

item.title: Google Business Profile for real estate agents: a step-by-step guide
item.description: Your Google Business Profile is often the first thing people see when they search for an agent near them. Here is how to set it up properly.

item.title: How real estate agents can get recommended by ChatGPT and AI search
item.description: More buyers and sellers now ask AI assistants who to work with. Here is what influences those answers and what you can do about it.
